known_behavior: Illustrator links to the Prism-exported PDF, not directly to .pzfx.
The AI placed item stores the .pzfx path in note and URL metadata.
Running refresh_prism_to_ai.py re-exports from Prism and refreshes/saves the open AI document.
SVG opens in Illustrator with editable text, but Illustrator scripting could not place SVG as a linked placedItem on this machine.
PDF works as a linked placedItem, which is the updateable route.
Prism creates numbered exports instead of overwriting existing files; refresh_prism_to_ai.py normalizes the newest numbered export back to the stable linked file path.
